control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during cleaning and preparation on V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on V-4110, LT-4110 and PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 July 2026 an incident occurred on V-4110, LT-4110 and PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
